cleared.why: The open square made when the Wien was vaulted over (1894-1900). Today's footprints here are underground-railway entrances, kiosks and later buildings; what small structures stood on the square in 1908 was not established, so the level leaves it open apart from the Secession and Otto Wagner's two pavilions.
The ground of the Kunstschau of 1908: the empty building plot on which the Konzerthaus (opened 1913) and the Akademietheater were built afterwards.
